# YardageMath

> Free, accurate construction and yard calculators with the math shown. US units, client-side, no sign-up. Built and maintained by Sikander Mushtaq.

## Calculators

- [Cubic Yard Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/cubic-yard-calculator/): Area and depth to cubic yards, tons and bags for gravel, soil, mulch or concrete.
- [Concrete Block Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/concrete-block-calculator/): How many CMU or cinder blocks a wall needs, plus mortar and cost.
- [Brick Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/brick-calculator/): How many bricks and 80-lb mortar bags for a wall or veneer by brick size, minus openings, with cost.
- [Concrete Slab Cost Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/concrete-slab-cost-calculator/): Slab cubic yards, bags vs ready-mix, and total cost per square foot (2026 prices).
- [Yards of Concrete Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/yards-of-concrete-calculator/): How many cubic yards of concrete for a slab, footing strip or round column, plus bags and cost.
- [Topsoil Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/topsoil-calculator/): Topsoil cubic yards, tons and bags for lawns and beds.
- [Pea Gravel Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/pea-gravel-calculator/): Pea gravel cubic yards, tons and 0.5 cu ft bags by area and depth.
- [Square Yard Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/square-yard-calculator/): Convert feet and multiple rooms to square yards, with waste and cost.
- [Landscape Material Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/landscape-materials-calculator/): Yards, tons and bags for mulch, rock, soil, sand, decomposed granite and more.
- [Mulch Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/mulch-calculator/): How much mulch for beds and tree rings: cubic yards, 2 or 3 cu ft bags, coverage and bulk vs bagged cost.
- [Gravel Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/gravel-calculator/): How much gravel for a driveway, path or patio: cubic yards, tons, bags, coverage and cost by gravel type.
- [Sand Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/sand-calculator/): How much sand for a sandbox, paver base or fill: cubic yards, tons, 50-lb bags, coverage and bulk vs bagged cost.
- [Paver Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/paver-calculator/): How many pavers for a patio or walkway by size and pattern, plus gravel base, bedding sand, edging and cost.
- [Paver Base Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/paver-base-calculator/): How much gravel base and bedding sand under pavers by project depth: tons, cubic yards, bags and bulk vs bagged cost.
- [Retaining Wall Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/retaining-wall-calculator/): How many segmental retaining wall blocks and caps, plus base gravel, drainage stone, pipe and cost, by block size.
- [Fill Dirt Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/fill-dirt-calculator/): How much fill dirt to fill a hole, raise a yard or level a low spot: cubic yards, tons and dump truck loads, with compaction.
- [Landscape Rock Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/landscape-rock-calculator/): How much decorative rock for beds and borders: tons, cubic yards, bags, coverage per ton and bulk vs bagged cost by rock type.
- [Asphalt Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/asphalt-calculator/): How many tons of asphalt for a driveway, pad or patch: tons, cubic yards, square yards, truckloads, coverage and cost, with an optional gravel base.
- [Fence Post Concrete Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/fence-post-concrete-calculator/): How many bags of concrete per fence post and in total, with the post subtracted, gravel base, fast-setting or regular bags, and cost.
- [Lawn Mowing Cost Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/lawn-mowing-cost-calculator/): What a cut should cost (homeowner) or what to charge (pro), per cut and per season.
- [Block Wall Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/block-wall-calculator/): Courses, blocks, cap blocks, mortar, grout, rebar and total material cost.
- [Concrete Block Weight Chart & Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/concrete-block-weight/): Weights for 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 inch CMU, normal and lightweight, plus total load, pallet and per-trip weight.
- [CMU Block Sizes and Dimensions](https://yardagemath.com/cmu-block-sizes/): Nominal vs actual CMU dimensions, half and half-high units, plus a course converter for wall height and length.
- [Concrete Footing Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/concrete-footing-calculator/): Concrete for strip, pad and round pier footings, with cubic yards, 80-lb bags and cost.
- [Cinder Block Fill Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/cinder-block-fill-calculator/): Concrete or grout to fill cinder block cores by blocks or wall size, with cubic feet, yards and 80-lb bags.
- [Acres per Hour Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/acres-per-hour-calculator/): Acres per hour from working width, speed and field efficiency, and time to finish.
- [Sod Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/sod-calculator/): How much sod for a new lawn: square feet, pallets, slabs or rolls and cost, with extra for cuts.
- [Gutter Slope Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/gutter-slope-calculator/): Gutter drop, pitch and downspout count for any run length.
- [Rip Rap Calculator](https://yardagemath.com/rip-rap-calculator/): Riprap cubic yards and tons by area and layer thickness, with stone classes.

## Hubs

- [Landscaping & Yardage Calculators](https://yardagemath.com/landscaping/): Soil, mulch, gravel, rock, sand, pavers and square yards.
- [Lawn Care Calculators](https://yardagemath.com/lawn/): Mowing cost and acres-per-hour mowing time.

- [Free Calculators for Your Website](https://yardagemath.com/free-calculators-for-your-website/): Embed our mulch, gravel, topsoil and concrete calculators free, with one line of code.
